claim: The judiciary does not even get 1% of the Kenyan national budget.
speaker: David Maraga
evidence_text:
[1] Q: What share percentage did the judiciary receive from the Kenyan national budget in 2019/20?
    A: 0.7%
[2] Q: What share percentage did the judiciary receive from the Kenyan national budget in 2020/21?
    A: 0.6%
[3] Q: Has the judiciary ever received 1% of the Kenyan national budget?
    A: Yes
[4] Q: When was the claim made?
    A: 1st August 2020.
label: supported

evidence_text:

    A: Michael Jones
[2] Q: Why did Facebook flag the post
    A: Facebook flagged the post as false because the original story came from a site that publishes fiction

claim: Since Trump took office, 7 million more people lack health insurance that used to have it.
speaker: Bernie Sanders
evidence_text:
[1] Q: Where are Sanders' numbers from?
    A: The January 2019 Gallup estimate
[2] Q: What does the Gallup estimate to be the amount of people who lost insurance in 2019?
    A: 2.8 percentage points from its low in 2016. Gallup ran the numbers and converted that rise into 7 million people who lost insurance.
[3] Q: What number did the government survey say?
    A: About 1.3 million people.
label: conflicting evidence/cherrypicking
